content.review: The proposed reweighting trick is interesting but the ablation removing component A is missing. I would also like to see OOD evaluation; without that I cannot tell whether the reported 73.4% accuracy is robust. Minor: Figure 2 caption has a typo.

Strong empirical results but the related work is incremental. The paper feels very similar to Snell et al. 2024 — what is the new contribution beyond reweighting? Also, no significance test on 5 seeds.
Clarity issues throughout Section 3: notation is ambiguous and the algorithm block is hard to follow. Consider rephrasing the loss derivation. Minor typo in Table 2 caption.
